methodology.categoryReference: Saved categories, excluding Uncategorized. Posts with no topic labels are unlabelled and excluded from category accuracy denominators. Missing tags are counted as false positives for historical agreement, not proof of editorial irrelevance.
methodology.upgradeReference: Primary score uses only explicitly saved, currently supported upgrades. Missing values are not confirmed negatives; their agreement with none is a separate diagnostic. Legacy offers are excluded from accuracy.
methodology.input: Full Markdown title and body; YAML frontmatter, labels, publication date, and source URL are not sent to the classifier.
methodology.holdout: All recent archive posts except the category-definition source URLs and the 16 earlier development evaluation posts. No model or prompt changes during this backtest.
